notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Added some new Lemon drops, two legendaries and a common.
- Million Dollar Lemon
- Lemoon
- Lime

Adjusted rarities for normal percentages, legendaries, epics and exotics are now slightly lower to obtain, thanks for everyone that participated so early.
